title: Privacy policy.
intro: This page is reserved for the approved NMESIS privacy notice. The final notice will reflect the website’s actual forms, hosting, analytics and connected services.

sections.title: Project enquiries
sections.text: This preview includes name, email and project enquiry fields. The forms are not connected to an inbox yet. The final notice will describe the information handled once they are connected.

sections.title: Purpose & retention
sections.text: The approved notice will explain how enquiries are handled, who can access them and how long they are retained.

sections.title: Cookies & analytics
sections.text: Cookie and analytics wording will be completed after the live website’s services have been selected and reviewed.

sections.title: Connected services
sections.text: Hosting, enquiry delivery, video and any analytics providers will be named in the final notice where applicable.

sections.title: Data handling
sections.text: The final notice will describe the relevant handling practices and contact process. This placeholder makes no claims about systems that have not been connected.

sections.title: Privacy contact
sections.text: Contact info@nmesis.io with questions about NMESIS. The approved notice will include the process for privacy requests and the applicable company details.
